regimes.full: all gallery images per identity (no sampling)
regimes.g3: uniform without replacement, k=3 per identity
regimes.g1: uniform without replacement, k=1 per identity

rng: numpy.random.RandomState(seed); identity order = sorted(); pool order = sorted(); idx = numpy.sort(rng.choice(len(pool), k, replace=False))
no_oracle: no model score, no correctness, no best-of-n selection is used
